description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa-Fase II es mejorar la competitividad del sector productivo y el nivel de vida de la poblacin del Paraguay a travs del incremento en la seguridad del suministro y del aprovechamiento eficiente de la generacin elctrica renovable disponible.

The general objective of Program Phase II is to make the productive sector more competitive and raise the standard of living for the people of Paraguay through more reliable supply and more efficient use of the country's available electric power generation capacity.
